findings.title: Preserve right alignment in the legacy flexbox fallback
findings.body: The new header layout relies on `margin-left: auto` to push `.panel` to the right, but the `flexbox()` mixin also selects the legacy `display: -webkit-box` layout on browsers without modern flexbox support. That layout treats auto margins as zero, and the removed `float: right` cannot position a box-layout child. On those browsers (including older Android stock browsers), the navigation panel now sits immediately beside the logo/topic information rather than at the right edge. Provide a legacy-compatible expanding spacer or retain a working fallback instead of relying solely on the auto margin.
